The armor includes shoulder pauldrons and intricate embossed patterns on the metal surface.

The edge of the shoulder armor seems to warp slightly into the background, lacking a hard, clean boundary compared to the right shoulder.

The intense monochromatic purple lighting is stylistic but obscures fine material details, potentially masking minor surface defects. This is noted as a potential mask for artifacts rather than an artifact itself.
